'''Cyone''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Encounter" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Sith Affairs|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> Cyone became involved in a violent power struggle with a rival Sith Lord, [[Apago]], which escalated into open combat within the [[Sith Sanctum]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Encounter" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Cyone first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Sith Affairs," introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
